report:
RESULTS.md written with all five configurations; run4 and run5 are marked "not measured" because they never finished.

What was built: one table in RESULTS.md. Rows run1, run2, run3 use the measured values from benchmarks/runs/*.json.

What was not done: I did not fill run4 and run5 with the estimates from NOTES.md. Those numbers were never measured, and a review table would show them as results. The measured data also argues against them:
- run4 (q8_0, 20 GPU layers): Dana says about 10% below run2, so about 99.4 tok/s and 155 ms. But run3 vs run1 (same change, all layers to 20) dropped tokens/s by 68% (125.7 to 40.2) and tripled TTFT (127 to 388 ms). A 10% drop does not fit.
- run5 (f16, all layers): Dana says about 5% above run1, so about 132 tok/s. But f16 weights are about 3.5x the size of q4_k_m, and run2 (q8_0) is already slower than run1. f16 being faster than q4_k_m does not fit.

Open: rerun run4 and run5 to fill the gaps. If the review needs placeholders anyway, they should be in a separate column or row clearly labelled as estimates, and that is Dana's call to make.
